title: Register a new NFS backup store
summary: Create one explicitly selected backup-only NFS storage without adopting an existing storage ID or covering an existing path.
requirements: Exactly one explicitly selected Proxmox host
Reviewed existing NFS export and mount options
Absent storage ID and default mountpoint
Pinned cmdmesh.proxmox collection with the create-only guard
verification: Verify actual NFS export, filesystem type, mountpoint and mount options on the managed host
Verify a private owned destination before any backup write
Do not count a mount or storage status as a completed backup or restore
